# Mediterranean Sunday Brunch Plan

A comprehensive guide for hosting a 6-adult Mediterranean brunch in London, featuring vibrant flavors and synchronized preparation.

## Mediterranean Brunch Menu
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/2d/Shakshuka_Stoves_and_Graze.jpg/1200px-Shakshuka_Stoves_and_Graze.jpg Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- **Spicy Shakshuka:** 8 eggs poached in a sauce of 800g tomatoes, 2 peppers, 1 onion, 4 garlic cloves, and 2 tsp harissa. Served with 1 large sourdough loaf.
- **Spinach & Feta Filo Pie:** 500g spinach, 250g feta, 3 eggs, and 1 pack filo pastry. **Gluten-Free Mod:** Prepare a crustless version in a separate ramekin using GF breadcrumbs or a GF puff pastry base for the specific guest.
- **Greek Yogurt Parfait Station:** 1kg Greek yogurt, 150ml honey, 150g toasted walnuts, and 300g seasonal berries.

## Shopping List & Budget (London, UK)
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/currency-pound.svg
- **Produce:** Spinach (£2.50), Peppers/Onion/Garlic (£3.00), Berries (£4.00) - Total: £9.50
- **Dairy/Eggs:** 12 Eggs (£3.50), Feta (£3.00), Greek Yogurt (£4.00), Butter (£2.00) - Total: £12.50
- **Pantry/Bakery:** Sourdough (£4.00), Filo/GF Pastry (£3.50), Harissa/Honey/Walnuts (£6.00) - Total: £13.50
- **Estimated Total Cost:** £35.50 (£5.92 per person)

## Preparation Timeline
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/clock.svg
- **09:00 - 09:30:** Prep vegetables; wilt and drain spinach thoroughly for the pie.
- **09:30 - 10:15:** Assemble Filo Pie and GF modification; set aside in fridge.
- **10:15 - 11:00:** Prepare Parfait station components; toast walnuts; slice sourdough.
- **11:00 - 11:30:** Bake Filo Pies (200°C); start Shakshuka base sauce on stovetop.
- **11:40 - 12:00:** Poach eggs in Shakshuka; warm sourdough; serve all dishes at 12:00.
